stem: Which inference about the preferred study times of all students who attend these two colleges is best supported by this information?

options.label: A
options.text: There are more students who attend College X than students who attend College Y.

options.label: B
options.text: The mode time preference for studying among students who attend College X is the morning.

options.label: C
options.text: More students who attend College Y like to study in the evening than in the morning and afternoon combined.

options.label: D
options.text: The percentage of students who prefer studying in the morning or afternoon is equal for students attending College X and College Y.

visual_elements: Bar graph titled Preferred Study Times with x-axis labeled Study Times showing Morning, Afternoon, Evening and y-axis labeled Number of Students from 0 to 9.
Key indicating black bars represent College X and gray bars represent College Y.
Bars for College X: Morning 8, Afternoon 3, Evening 2.
Bars for College Y: Morning 4, Afternoon 7, Evening 9.
